name: Umtali
description: Umtali is a 2-player Rummy game from Rhodesia (now Zimbabwe). 10 cards each. Features 5 meld types: sets (no Jacks), runs, marriages (K+Q same suit for double), single Jacks, and single-card extensions. Opponent gets one final turn after someone goes out. Two-card melds allowed in final turn.

history.origins: Umtali is a Rhodesian (now Zimbabwean) rummy game. It was popular on train journeys in colonial Rhodesia. The name comes from Umtali, a market town on the Salisbury-Beira railway line; it is described as an unusual rummy game from that tradition.
timeline: 20th century: popular on train journeys in colonial Rhodesia (now Zimbabwe); Umtali is the former name of a market town on the Salisbury-Beira railway.

setup.dealing: 10 each (or 11 to non-dealer). Top of stock starts discard.

rules.objective: Players aim to score the most points over four rounds by forming melds (sets, runs, marriages, single Jacks, extensions) and going out; face cards and tens count 5 points each, others 1; marriages score double.
rules.gameplay: Draw-meld-discard. 5 meld types: Sets (3-4 same rank, no Jacks), Runs (3+ same suit consecutive), Marriages (K+Q same suit = double pts), Single Jacks, Extensions. Deep discard pile draw allowed if meld immediately. Final turn for opponent. Two-card melds OK in final turn.

strategy.basic: Focus on marriages for double points.

scoring.description: Face cards/10s = 5pts. Others = 1pt. Marriages = double. 4 rounds total.
